# Title: أسعار الذهب السعودية (saudigoldrates.com)

> أسعار الذهب اليومية واللحظية في المملكة العربية السعودية بالريال السعودي والدولار الأمريكي.

## Core Features
- Live 24K, 22K, 21K, and 18K gold prices updated every 15 minutes.
- Real-time bullion and gold coin pricing (Ounces, Tolas, Kilograms).
- Used gold (scrap gold / ذهب مستعمل وكسر) buying rates for jewelry shops.
- Zakat Gold Calculator based on current Nisab threshold (85g 24K).

## Primary URLs
- [Homepage](https://saudigoldrates.com/)
- [21-Karat Gold Rates](https://saudigoldrates.com/21-karat)
- [Bullion & Coins](https://saudigoldrates.com/bullion)
- [Used Gold Rates](https://saudigoldrates.com/used-gold)
- [Zakat Calculator](https://saudigoldrates.com/zakat-calculator)
